//: Five-orites Scoop — Firestore Composite Indexes. Every entry here is matched to a query in src/; an index nothing queries is pure write cost and noise in the Firebase console. Three were removed as inverses that no query can use: products(isActive, setNumber, variantName), products(isActive, setNumber) and vouchers(code, isActive). No query in the app orders by setNumber, variantName or code at all — the catalogue is ordered in memory. Note Firestore auto-creates single-field indexes, so a lone orderBy needs no entry here.
